Road conditions

Roads

Road incidents are events. Road conditions are not.

no key required CORS-open

Placescopes every section below · incidents arrive through /events?layer=road_incident; conditions are projections of live state, served only as the road_segment and chain_control map layers

place

Incidents

severity · headline · id
What this is

CHP and Caltrans incidents on these corridors, each AI-enhanced into a readable summary with an impact-driven severity.

These are stored events — the same records /events?layer=road_incident returns — so a row opens the full record and its revision history.

Source

Road segments

GET …/map/road_segment.geojson
road · status · congestion · travel · delay · distance
What this is

One row per monitored road, live from Google Routes travel times and Caltrans status. Delay is against the road's free-flow duration; status is AI-determined, with the explanation shown when a road is not fully open.

A segment is baseline state — it never appears in /events.

Source

Chain control

GET …/map/chain_control.geojson
level · highway · direction · note
What this is

Active chain requirements from Caltrans — R1 chains or 4WD · R2 chains except 4WD · R3 chains required, all vehicles.

Empty is a clean report

It means the source reported no controls — not a failed feed. A failed feed says UNAVAILABLE in the source block above.

Source

To read those two condition layers as geometry — with their metadata block beside the map — use the Map screen.
